title: Use standard Dask configuration
subtitle: Replace our custom compute-profile system with existing frameworks.
context: GTSfM turns photos into a 3D model. Dask assigns the work to CPU/GPU workers.
before: Our own JSON format, saved-profile database, API, validation and UI to maintain.
after: Existing YAML field + Hydra construct Dask workers. Dask handles policy files, environment settings and memory units.
why: Reuse standard tools. Keep the reconstruction algorithm unchanged.
finding: Four real API-to-GPU runs; complete exports and named image pairs compared.
scope: Exact exported results on four images. This is a maintenance improvement; speed, accuracy and larger-scene gains remain unproven.
